input.quote: d. Ownership. Notwithstanding the license granted under section 2.1, TrueLink retains all of its ownership and license rights in the Interface.
input.rationale: The only ownership provision (§2(d)) is one-directional: it confirms TrueLink's rights in the Interface but nowhere states that Client retains ownership of Client Content, Client's Intellectual Property or its borrower/customer data. The TrueLink Intellectual Property definition (p0017) sweeps in "improvements... materials... data, know-how... programs, subroutines, tools" associated with the Interface, so Support Services work product created and paid for by Client could vest in TrueLink with no assignment and no licence back — failing both the preferred and the fallback position (which requires at minimum a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense deliverables). Confidentiality treatment of Client's IP and "all results of the Hosting and Support Services" as Client Proprietary Information (p0065) is a non-disclosure protection, not an ownership allocation, and the retained ownership of domains/Client Content on termination (p0078) is limited to the discontinuation scenario. Redline adds the Customer Data/IP retention sentence, an assignment of Support Services deliverables with a licence-back for embedded TrueLink IP, and a no-joint-ownership statement, leaving TrueLink's Interface ownership intact. Noted but not separately flagged: the broad §8(d) licence to "license, resell, exploit" Credit Data is a negotiated carve-out limited to aged raw third-party credit data not combined with Client Proprietary Information and is subject to the Non-Competition Agreement, so we preserve it expressly rather than reopen it.

ops.oldText: d. Ownership. Notwithstanding the license granted under section 2.1, TrueLink retains all of its ownership and license rights in the Interface.
ops.newText: d. Ownership. Notwithstanding the license granted under section 2.1, TrueLink retains all of its ownership and license rights in the Interface. Client retains all right, title and interest in and to the Client Content, Client's Intellectual Property and all data of Client and of its borrowers, loan applicants, customers and brokers (including Credit Data), and nothing in this Agreement operates as an assignment or transfer to TrueLink of any of the foregoing or creates any joint ownership therein, other than the license granted under Section 8(d). TrueLink hereby assigns to Client all right, title and interest in any deliverables and work product created specifically for Client in the course of the Support Services, excluding TrueLink's Intellectual Property existing prior to or developed independently of such Support Services, in which TrueLink hereby grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense such TrueLink Intellectual Property to the extent embedded in such deliverables for the purposes of Client's business.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a sentence confirming that Client keeps ownership of its content, intellectual property and borrower/customer data, and that Support Services deliverables are assigned to Client with a licence back to any embedded TrueLink IP; our playbook requires that we own what we pay for and what we put in, with no assignment or joint ownership of our data. TrueLink's ownership of the Interface is untouched, and the existing Credit Data licence in Section 8(d) is expressly preserved.
proposal.summary: Add Client data/IP retention and Support Services deliverable assignment with licence-back to §2(d) Ownership.
